cd /workspace/pulumi && ./pulumi-export | jq ' def get_subnets: [.deployment.resources[] | select(.type == "aws:ec2/subnet:Subnet") | {subnet_id: .outputs.id, name: (.urn | split("::") | .[-1]), vpc_id: .outputs.vpcId, cidr: .outputs.cidrBlock, az: .outputs.availabilityZone}]; def get_instances: [.deployment.resources[] | select(.type == "aws:ec2/instance:Instance") | {subnet_id: .outputs.subnetId, instance_id: .outputs.id}]; def get_network_interfaces: [.deployment.resources[] | select(.type == "aws:ec2/networkInterface:NetworkInterface") | {subnet_id: .outputs.subnetId, eni_id: .outputs.id}]; def analyze: (get_subnets) as $subnets | (get_instances) as $instances | (get_network_interfaces) as $enis | ($instances + $enis | map(.subnet_id) | unique) as $used_subnets | { all_subnets: $subnets, used_subnets: $used_subnets, empty_subnets: ($subnets | map(select(.subnet_id | IN($used_subnets[] | select(. != null)) | not))) }; analyze '

cd /workspace/pulumi && ./pulumi-export | jq ' # Get all managed subnets with their regions [.deployment.resources[] | select(.type == "aws:ec2/subnet:Subnet") | { subnet_id: .outputs.id, name: (.urn | split("::") | .[-1]), region: (.outputs.availabilityZone | rtrimstr("a") | rtrimstr("b") | rtrimstr("c") | rtrimstr("d")), az: .outputs.availabilityZone, vpc_id: .outputs.vpcId, cidr: .outputs.cidrBlock }] | sort_by(.region, .subnet_id) as $subnets | # Get all instances and their subnet associations [.deployment.resources[] | select(.type == "aws:ec2/instance:Instance") | { instance_id: .outputs.id, instance_name: (.urn | split("::") | .[-1]), subnet_id: .outputs.subnetId }] as $instances | # Map subnet_id to instances ($instances | group_by(.subnet_id) | map({subnet_id: .[0].subnet_id, instances: map(.instance_name)}) | index_by(.subnet_id)) as $instance_map | # Find empty subnets (no instances) { managed_subnets: $subnets, instances_by_subnet: $instance_map, empty_subnets: ($subnets | map(select(.subnet_id as $sid | $instance_map[$sid] == null))) } '

cd /workspace/pulumi && ./pulumi-export > /tmp/pulumi-state.json && cat > /tmp/analyze_subnets.jq << 'EOF' # Get all managed subnets [.deployment.resources[] | select(.type == "aws:ec2/subnet:Subnet") | { subnet_id: .outputs.id, name: (.urn | split("::") | .[-1]), az: .outputs.availabilityZone, vpc_id: .outputs.vpcId, cidr: .outputs.cidrBlock }] as $subnets | # Get all instances [.deployment.resources[] | select(.type == "aws:ec2/instance:Instance") | { instance_id: .outputs.id, instance_name: (.urn | split("::") | .[-1]), subnet_id: .outputs.subnetId }] as $instances | # Extract used subnet IDs ($instances | map(.subnet_id) | unique) as $used_subnet_ids | # Find empty subnets and build report { total_subnets: ($subnets | length), subnets_with_instances: ($used_subnet_ids | length), empty_subnets: [$subnets[] | select(.subnet_id | IN($used_subnet_ids[]) | not)] } EOF jq -f /tmp/analyze_subnets.jq /tmp/pulumi-state.json

cat > /tmp/detailed_analysis.jq << 'EOF' # Get all managed subnets [.deployment.resources[] | select(.type == "aws:ec2/subnet:Subnet") | { subnet_id: .outputs.id, name: (.urn | split("::") | .[-1]), az: .outputs.availabilityZone, vpc_id: .outputs.vpcId, cidr: .outputs.cidrBlock }] | sort_by(.az, .subnet_id) as $subnets | # Get all instances [.deployment.resources[] | select(.type == "aws:ec2/instance:Instance") | { instance_id: .outputs.id, instance_name: (.urn | split("::") | .[-1]), subnet_id: .outputs.subnetId }] as $instances | # Extract used subnet IDs from managed resources only ($instances | map(select(.subnet_id | IN($subnets[].subnet_id))) | map(.subnet_id) | unique) as $used_managed_subnet_ids | # Build detailed report { managed_subnets: $subnets, instances: $instances, empty_subnets: [$subnets[] | select(.subnet_id | IN($used_managed_subnet_ids[]) | not)] } EOF jq -f /tmp/detailed_analysis.jq /tmp/pulumi-state.json

cd /workspace/pulumi && ./pulumi-export 2>/dev/null | jq ' # Get all managed subnets [.deployment.resources[] | select(.type == "aws:ec2/subnet:Subnet") | { subnet_id: .outputs.id, name: (.urn | split("::") | .[-1]), az: .outputs.availabilityZone, vpc_id: .outputs.vpcId, cidr: .outputs.cidrBlock }] | sort_by(.az, .subnet_id) as $subnets | # Get all instances [.deployment.resources[] | select(.type == "aws:ec2/instance:Instance") | { instance_id: .outputs.id, instance_name: (.urn | split("::") | .[-1]), subnet_id: .outputs.subnetId }] as $instances | # Extract used subnet IDs from managed resources only ($instances | map(select(.subnet_id | IN($subnets[].subnet_id))) | map(.subnet_id) | unique) as $used_managed_subnet_ids | # Build detailed report { managed_subnets: $subnets, instance_to_subnet_mapping: $instances, empty_subnets: [$subnets[] | select(.subnet_id | IN($used_managed_subnet_ids[]) | not)] } '
jq empty /tmp/state.json && echo "Valid JSON" || echo "Invalid JSON"

cat > /tmp/final_analysis.jq << 'ANALYSIS' # Get all managed subnets [.deployment.resources[] | select(.type == "aws:ec2/subnet:Subnet")] as $subnet_resources | ($subnet_resources | map({ subnet_id: .outputs.id, name: (.urn | split("::") | .[-1]), region: (.outputs.availabilityZone | .[:-1]), az: .outputs.availabilityZone, vpc_id: .outputs.vpcId, cidr: .outputs.cidrBlock })) as $subnets | # Get all instances and their subnets [.deployment.resources[] | select(.type == "aws:ec2/instance:Instance") | { instance_name: (.urn | split("::") | .[-1]), subnet_id: .outputs.subnetId }] as $instances | # Get all network interfaces [.deployment.resources[] | select(.type == "aws:ec2/networkInterface:NetworkInterface") | { eni_id: .outputs.id, subnet_id: .outputs.subnetId }] as $enis | # Combine all interfaces (instances create implicit ENIs) ($instances | map(.subnet_id)) + ($enis | map(.subnet_id)) as $all_interface_subnets | ($all_interface_subnets | unique) as $used_subnet_ids | # Find empty subnets (managed subnets with no instances or ENIs) [ $subnets[] | if (.subnet_id | IN($used_subnet_ids[])) then empty else { subnet_id: .subnet_id, name: .name, region: .region, az: .az, vpc_id: .vpc_id, cidr: .cidr } end ] as $empty_subnets | { summary: { total_managed_subnets: ($subnets | length), subnets_with_interfaces: ($used_subnet_ids | length), empty_subnets_count: ($empty_subnets | length), regions_checked: ($subnets | map(.region) | unique | sort) }, all_managed_subnets: ($subnets | sort_by(.region, .az)), empty_subnets: $empty_subnets } ANALYSIS jq -f /tmp/final_analysis.jq /tmp/state.json

python3 << 'PYTHON' import json import sys with open('/tmp/state.json', 'r') as f: state = json.load(f) # Get all managed subnets subnets = {} for resource in state['deployment']['resources']: if resource.get('type') == 'aws:ec2/subnet:Subnet': subnet_id = resource['outputs']['id'] subnets[subnet_id] = { 'subnet_id': subnet_id, 'name': resource['urn'].split('::')[-1], 'region': resource['outputs']['availabilityZone'][:-1], 'az': resource['outputs']['availabilityZone'], 'vpc_id': resource['outputs']['vpcId'], 'cidr': resource['outputs']['cidrBlock'] } # Get all instances and their subnets instance_subnets = set() instances = [] for resource in state['deployment']['resources']: if resource.get('type') == 'aws:ec2/instance:Instance': subnet_id = resource['outputs'].get('subnetId') instance_name = resource['urn'].split('::')[-1] instances.append({ 'instance_name': instance_name, 'subnet_id': subnet_id }) instance_subnets.add(subnet_id) # Get all network interfaces (explicit ENIs) eni_subnets = set() for resource in state['deployment']['resources']: if resource.get('type') == 'aws:ec2/networkInterface:NetworkInterface': subnet_id = resource['outputs'].get('subnetId') eni_subnets.add(subnet_id) # Combine all interfaces used_subnet_ids = instance_subnets | eni_subnets # Find empty subnets (managed subnets with no instances or ENIs) empty_subnets = [] for subnet_id, subnet_info in subnets.items(): if subnet_id not in used_subnet_ids: empty_subnets.append(subnet_info) # Sort results empty_subnets_sorted = sorted(empty_subnets, key=lambda x: (x['region'], x['az'])) all_subnets_sorted = sorted(subnets.values(), key=lambda x: (x['region'], x['az'])) # Build report report = { 'summary': { 'total_managed_subnets': len(subnets), 'subnets_with_interfaces': len(used_subnet_ids), 'empty_subnets_count': len(empty_subnets), 'regions_checked': sorted(set(s['region'] for s in subnets.values())) }, 'all_managed_subnets': all_subnets_sorted, 'empty_subnets': empty_subnets_sorted, 'instances': sorted(instances, key=lambda x: x['subnet_id']) } print(json.dumps(report, indent=2)) PYTHON

commands: cat > /tmp/vpc-analysis.sh << 'EOF' #!/bin/bash # Extract VPCs echo "=== VPCs by Region ===" jq -r '.deployment.resources[] | select(.type == "aws:ec2/vpc:Vpc") | "\(.urn | split("::")[-1]): \(.outputs.id)"' /tmp/pulumi-state.json | while read line; do urn=$(echo "$line" | cut -d: -f1) id=$(echo "$line" | cut -d: -f2 | xargs) # Find the provider to determine region provider_urn=$(jq -r ".deployment.resources[] | select(.outputs.id == \"$id\" and .type == \"aws:ec2/vpc:Vpc\") | .provider" /tmp/pulumi-state.json) if [[ "$provider_urn" == *"usw1"* ]]; then region="us-west-1" elif [[ "$provider_urn" == *"usw2"* ]]; then region="us-west-2" elif [[ "$provider_urn" == *"use1"* ]]; then region="us-east-1" else region="unknown" fi echo "$urn (${id}) - Region: $region" done echo "" echo "=== Instances by VPC ===" # Get all subnets mapped to VPCs declare -A subnet_to_vpc while IFS= read -r line; do subnet=$(echo "$line" | jq -r '.subnetId') vpc=$(echo "$line" | jq -r '.vpcId') subnet_to_vpc[$subnet]=$vpc done < <(jq -c '.deployment.resources[] | select(.type == "aws:ec2/subnet:Subnet") | {subnetId: .outputs.id, vpcId: .outputs.vpcId}' /tmp/pulumi-state.json) # Get all instances declare -A vpc_instances while IFS= read -r line; do instance_id=$(echo "$line" | jq -r '.id') instance_urn=$(echo "$line" | jq -r '.urn | split("::")[-1]') subnet=$(echo "$line" | jq -r '.outputs.subnetId') vpc=${subnet_to_vpc[$subnet]} if [ -z "$vpc" ]; then vpc="default-vpc" fi if [ -z "${vpc_instances[$vpc]}" ]; then vpc_instances[$vpc]="$instance_urn" else vpc_instances[$vpc]="${vpc_instances[$vpc]}, $instance_urn" fi done < <(jq -c '.deployment.resources[] | select(.type == "aws:ec2/instance:Instance")' /tmp/pulumi-state.json) # Print results for vpc in "${!vpc_instances[@]}"; do echo "$vpc: ${vpc_instances[$vpc]}" done EOF bash /tmp/vpc-analysis.sh
